title: Hosea and the Assyrian Conquest of Israel
description: Hosea, son of Ela, becomes king of Israel and becomes a vassal of Assyria under Shalmaneser. He attempts to throw off the overlordship by seeking help from So, king of Egypt, but is discovered, arrested, and thrown into prison. The king of Assyria besieges Samaria for three years, captures the city, and carries the Israelites away to Assyria, where they are settled in Halah, by the Habor River in Gozan, and in the cities of Media.
